scope: Reproduction instructions, selection rules, and saved measurement evidence; not a proof of global optimality.

findings.finding: A fresh reader lacked the checkout and environment preparation steps.
findings.resolution: README now identifies the working folder, two checker revisions, explicit pinned CSLib setup, result paths, and selection replay command.

findings.finding: P09 secondary versions rechecked the selected proof but did not freshly remeasure the original; the selector initially assumed original records existed.
findings.resolution: Selector requires paired controls on the primary version; secondary correctness checks preserve originalRemeasured=false and the source note.

findings.finding: A workflow can complete even though an experimental candidate fails.
findings.resolution: Controls and per-candidate validity/three-run records govern scores. experiment.py adds controlsValid, and the selector refuses missing primary controls.

findings.finding: Previously selected proofs and newly edited proofs could be credited together.
findings.resolution: Starting snapshot and author/source manifest are preserved. All claimed additional points use the paired starting proof; retained proofs receive zero additional points.

findings.finding: Custom P12 validation and chosen benchmark cases could be mistaken for an official or held-out model evaluation.
findings.resolution: P12 remains a separate protocol and is excluded from the common mean; no model success-rate or $3-compliance claim.

independentNativeAudit.note: Fresh-context auditor reported byte reconstruction against pinned git sources, frozen runtime identity, raw/scaled heartbeat and allowed axioms. Its final formatted response was interrupted by account usage limits; this records only the concrete completed checks it delivered.

notConsolidated: Prior dated research reports and dashboard results remain historical snapshots; only new report/readme references are added.
portabilityAudit: No stack-neutral portability claim; the runbook explicitly requires pinned Lean projects and the recorded Arena checkout.

integrationCheck.purpose: Exercise the final portable adapter; separate 3-run data determines selection.

negativeSelectionCheck.finding: Selection stopped when a stronger primary-valid candidate still had pending designated versions.
